query_plan.query: What is the average elevation of airports in meters?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by airport id, calculate the average elevation.
steps.query: Return all airports together with their elevation, with their airport id and airport name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(elevation_m) AS avg_elevation FROM airports

s1.sql_query: SELECT airports.airport, airports.name, airports.elevation_m FROM airports
